# Generalized Wiener attack implementation

A proof-of-concept implementation in SageMath for the attack presented in the paper **A New Generalized Attack on RSA-like Cryptosystems**.

To test the attack, you have three options

1) Execute the notebook attack.ipynb
=============================================

```python
load("attack.sage")
```


```python
N, e = gen_weak_RSA_instance(1024); print(f"{N=} \n{40*'='}\n{e=}\n")
```
